corpus.shape: linear history, one file changed per commit, packed

budget.source: ticket reco-cey; `benchmarks/budgets.json` has no `cold.walk` family yet

notes: cold = first walk in a fresh process; the OS page cache is not dropped (that needs root), so a first run on a cold machine will be slower than this
the budget walk is first-parent, ids only, streamed and dropped: it is what `fathom log` and the e1.2 store writer actually do
`git rev-list --count` is recorded as a floor, not a competitor: it never decodes a commit
no `cold.walk.ms` budget family exists in benchmarks/budgets.json; adding one (with `rss.walk.peak_mib`) is the follow-up this report argues for
